title: Dust Devil
html:
A level 34 Dust Devil that attacks with corrode (melee).

Fighting it

Weak shockslash   Resists burncrush

A weakness adds 30% damage and a resistance takes 30% off (the game's own rule).

Reagent: Sirocco Core (infuses an enchant). About 1 kill in 500, 1 in 50 from an elite. Reforging
